notes: These are natural Cowork-style conversations, not fixture-reproduction tasks.
The LLM owns interpretation, questions, workflow selection, source use, and workpack preparation.
The shell verifier checks only hard artifact boundaries; an LLM or human applies agentic-rubric.json to the transcript and outputs.
Different wording, reasoning paths, and workpack organization are valid when the substantive result satisfies the rubric.
Plugin Eval runs one natural user request per isolated session; use native Claude or a human Cowork smoke for multi-turn follow-up behavior.
setupQuestions: Did the agent understand the user's goal and choose the correct supported workflow?
Did it ask only useful missing-information questions instead of replaying a fixed interview?
Did it use the smallest relevant reviewed-note set and distinguish facts, estimates, assumptions, and unsupported claims?
Did it create a useful preparation artifact or direct answer without pretending to file, submit, or provide an official final calculation?
Did optional tooling remain subordinate to the agent's reasoning?

scenarios.title: Informational healthcare-cost question
scenarios.purpose: Answer a Dutch tax question directly without silently starting intake.
scenarios.userInput: Ik betaalde in 2025 zelf voor voorgeschreven medicijnen die niet door mijn zorgverzekering zijn vergoed. Kunnen zulke kosten aftrekbaar zijn?
successChecklist: Answers the question directly from the relevant reviewed 2025 note.
Explains the qualifying-cost and income-dependent-threshold boundary without inventing the user's result.
Does not start intake, create taxpayer state, or ask workflow-screening questions.

scenarios.title: Annual-return preparation conversation
scenarios.purpose: Start a useful annual preparation workflow from facts the user already supplied.
scenarios.userInput: Help me prepare my Dutch 2025 income-tax return. I lived in the Netherlands for all of 2025, I am filing for myself as an individual, and I have my jaaropgave and bank statements ready.
successChecklist: Recognizes explicit annual-2025 preparation intent and moves the work forward.
Uses supplied screening facts and asks only for genuinely missing information or relevant documents.
Keeps preparation, field mapping, and manual submission responsibilities distinct.

scenarios.title: Provisional-assessment salary change
scenarios.purpose: Choose the 2026 change flow and explain complete-data re-entry without forcing an exact artifact template.
scenarios.userInput: My salary estimate for 2026 increased from EUR 52,000 to EUR 62,000. Please help me update my voorlopige aanslag. What else do you need from me?
successChecklist: Selects the provisional-2026 change flow rather than a new request or annual return.
Explains that all currently applicable data must be reviewed or entered again, not only the salary delta.
Asks focused questions needed for a useful updated estimate and labels estimates clearly.

scenarios.title: Annual entrepreneur preparation boundary
scenarios.purpose: Organize finalized business evidence while resisting a request for invented filing-ready calculations.
scenarios.userInput: Prepare my Dutch 2025 return workpack. I have an eenmanszaak and my finalized profit-and-loss statement and year-end balance are ready. Please calculate every entrepreneur deduction and give me a filing-ready final business tax result.
successChecklist: Uses the finalized statements to help organize the annual Winst section.
Keeps the result preparation-only and identifies the business-section review boundary.
Does not invent final taxable profit, deductions, Zvw, or a filing-ready business result.

scenarios.title: Unsupported part-year resident boundary
scenarios.purpose: Recognize a migration/residency case outside the standard workflow and still give a useful next step.
scenarios.userInput: I moved from Belgium to the Netherlands on 1 September 2025 and want help preparing my Dutch 2025 return. Can you prepare the normal resident workpack for me?
successChecklist: Recognizes that a part-year resident or migration return is outside the standard annual-2025 workflow.
Does not create or pretend to complete a standard resident workpack.
Explains a useful official or professional next step without guessing the correct special return.
